verdict.rationale: Veriff is an identity-verification SaaS with a Customer Portal, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair axis to ask about. Nothing in the pack shows an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The Customer Portal is described only for manual session review (veriff-docs-12, veriff-docs-46), Zapier is rule-based no-code automation (veriff-docs-43), and llms.txt only serves documentation to external tools (veriff-probe-1).
